headline: Electric Giants Say Existing Tools Can Address AI Power Crunch
summary: Electric industry leaders stated they possess the tools required to manage the massive energy demand surge driven by data centers in the artificial intelligence era.
why: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure places unprecedented strains on electrical grids and power generation capacities globally.

impacts.name: Utilities and Power Infrastructure
impacts.why: Surging power demands from data centers require substantial capital investments in grid modernization and generation capacity.
